sourceInformation.perspective: Fixed screen, overhead projection, horizontal defense lane
sourceInformation.tech: JavaScript / Canvas 2D / Web Audio; my-3D2dge 0.89.1 at 8ecc2f62353761187bdfe226f327b7ea5d2eb691 (focused settings, scaling and units patches); Hub v1 / client 1.4.0 at 35a1047f2067b2af3de3943f0fe452f39105d869, unchanged; PeerJS 1.5.5 / WebRTC; Node 24.
sourceInformation.artDirection: Original engine-native shaded procedural pixel art, mechanical masks, saucer fleets, rainbow temporal rift and clear geometric threats
sourceInformation.animation: Native E.Path Catmull arrivals, E.sprite / E.anim hulls, procedural banking, recoil, expressive mask and phase choreography; native particles and lighting.
sourceInformation.audio: Original code-only music, effects and filtered gibberish voice on separate native buses; saved music default 10%
sourceInformation.online: Host-authoritative 1–4-player shared-world co-op through AI Hub or standalone PeerJS/WebRTC rooms; public signaling and NAT traversal are external dependencies
sourceInformation.testing: Headless state and legitimate solo/four-pilot campaign runs; final-bundle Chromium, WebKit and Firefox; standard-pad stub, touch and narrow-screen profiles; OfflineAudioContext signal/mute checks; four Hub conformance scenarios; real two-context PeerJS/WebRTC room lifecycle. No physical pad, real iOS hardware or subjective listening.
sourceInformation.research: Inspected North American manual, William Cassidy written review, gameplay still and box art; PeerJS official docs and pinned engine/Hub docs; no video viewed. Original exact steering, timings and continuous score unknown.

testingFeedback: 10 distinct defects found and fixed; the issue ledger records each. Test-fixture errors and duplicate failures are excluded.
2 critical issues: narrow low-density screens could crop the defense lane, and a retry could inherit developer invulnerability/AI/speed while remaining eligible for a normal record. Both are fixed.

The legitimate full-campaign action playthrough: all eight waves, all four weapon families, every boss phase and a single victory, without invulnerability or phase skips. The packaged browser run verifies the real integration too.
Boot-only checks; they detect loading faults but miss late campaign behavior and multiplayer lifecycle errors.
engineFeedback: The dependency-free pixel renderer, native paths, animation, lighting, shell and exact headless stepping form a useful coherent base.
The arcade service uses alternating turns and three-letter initials; shared co-op and six-letter records needed custom rules. Native static shell pages also needed pagination for pad readability.
A deterministic serializable authoritative campaign world and a common action/snapshot protocol for Hub and standalone rooms.
Keeping native menus, audio lifecycle and local focus handling compatible with a shared world that continues running.

Added session-only settings (persist:false), hidden developer rows, fractional fitting for narrow/high-density displays, and unit-aware slider formatting. Only the bundled full engine is patched. The Hub client is unchanged.
Add an official shared-world arcade kit with compact snapshots, session-only tuning and controller-readable paged information screens.
promptFeedback: Concrete mechanics, complete-flow requirements and executable acceptance checks made the intended adaptation clear.
PLAN.md specifies an ultra planning configuration while TASK.md supplies this max build identity; TASK.md was used for the actual model, filename and delivery metadata.
Completing the campaign, controller-first presentation and two real network environments in one independently runnable HTML.
Provide a machine-readable acceptance checklist and one small canonical shared-world example alongside the prose.

aiHub.name: Attack of the Time Bandit Boss
aiHub.description: Slide beneath winding fleets, intercept four wicked weapon families and spend a shared time brake. Defend your century through eight waves and a three-phase finale, solo or with up to four pilots.
aiHub.controls: Stick / A D / arrows / drag: move; Cross / RT / Space / mouse: fire; Square / LT / Shift: time brake; Options / Esc: menu
